about_short_description.short_description: Cheiron is an exploration and production company that focuses on revitalizing and optimizing production in medium-sized, mature fields.

product.name: Exploration
product.description: Activities focused on near-field exploration to add to the company's reserve base in mature oil and gas fields.

product.name: Field Development
product.description: Planning and executing development projects to maximize production from mature oil and gas fields.

product.name: Production Operations
product.description: Managing day-to-day oil and gas production activities to sustain and optimize output from mature fields.

product.name: Asset Acquisition and Management
product.description: Acquiring and managing upstream oil and gas assets to expand production portfolio and operational footprint.

product.name: Gas Field Development
product.description: Developing offshore and onshore gas fields through drilling, platform installation, and production facility setup.
